mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Foreign Shareholder Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry / Registrar of Companies in the shareholder's jurisdiction of domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route: issue certified copy from the registry, notarize if required, obtain Apostille from the jurisdiction's Competent Authority. Consular Legalization route: issue certified copy, notarize, authenticate through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, then legalize at the Chinese Embassy or Consulate. The two routes are parallel alternatives and must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Active Status
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry / Registrar of Companies in the shareholder's jurisdiction of domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route: certified copy plus Apostille certificate from the designated Competent Authority. Consular Legalization route: certified copy plus notarization, Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication, and Chinese Consular legalization. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive; do not apply both.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution Authorizing Incorporation and Power of Attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the Foreign Shareholding Entity with company secretary countersignature and corporate seal
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route: notarize the board resolution or power of attorney, then obtain Apostille from the Competent Authority. Consular Legalization route: notarize, authenticate by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and legalize at the Chinese Embassy or Consulate. Apostille and consular legalization must be selected based on state membership and cannot be combined.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (Charter or Memorandum of Association) of the Foreign Shareholder Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry or registered corporate legal counsel of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route: registrar certified true copy plus Apostille. Consular Legalization route: certified true copy plus notarization, Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication, and Chinese Embassy or Consulate legalization. No sequential overlap is permitted between Apostille and consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter issued for the Foreign Shareholder Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate relationship bank of the foreign shareholder (branch manager's office or authorized signatory)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route: sign the bank reference letter before a notary, then obtain Apostille from the Competent Authority. Consular Legalization route: sign before a notary, authenticate at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, then legalize at the Chinese Embassy or Consulate. The chosen authentication path must correspond exclusively to the issuing state's status under the Apostille Convention.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening must be performed against the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, the European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the domestic sanctions and unreliable entity lists administered by the Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China and the People's Bank of China. All shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, directors, senior managers, and authorized signatories must be screened as Politically Exposed Persons at onboarding and continuously on a real-time basis. Any detection triggers enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification, and mandatory escalation to the AML compliance officer and external counsel.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Enterprise Name Application System (National Enterprise Name Clearance Online Portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Chinese company names must be recorded in simplified Chinese characters. The statutory four-tier naming convention is administrative division plus distinctive trade name plus industry or business characteristics plus firm type (Limited Liability Company). A foreign investor may use a phonetic transliteration of its corporate name as the trade name, and an English auxiliary name may be adopted, but the approved Chinese name is the exclusive legal name for registration and contract signing.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the SAMR online name clearance is rejected, the applicant must retrieve the written rejection and identify the statutory ground under the Regulations on the Administration of the Registration of Market Entities. Within 60 days of receipt of the rejection decision, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration application with the market regulation authority at the next higher level, or within 6 months may file administrative litigation with the competent people's court. The appeal must include the original application number, a revised compliant name, supporting documents, and legal arguments explaining why the rejection was erroneous; missing the deadline requires a completely fresh filing.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is generally rejected for a WFOE engaged in craft beer wholesale and export distribution. The SAMR requires a verifiable commercial premises lease with property ownership certificate and landlord consent; municipal tax authorities and banks require actual staff presence, original books and records, invoices, customs declarations, and cold-chain or keg storage arrangements. A virtual address will be treated as lacking commercial substance and will trigger higher bank KYC, tax verification, and likely refusal of the registered office filing for this industry.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: 75-85% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months of registration for a newly established WFOE in alcoholic beverage distribution. Checklist: (1) original lease and property ownership certificate; (2) company nameplate and office signage; (3) payroll and staff attendance records; (4) statutory books, bank statements, invoices and vouchers; (5) food business license, alcohol wholesale permit and import-export qualification; (6) warehouse, inventory and cold-chain records for keg beer. Inspection triggers include abnormal VAT issuance, export declaration mismatches, or absence of personnel at the registered address.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 4, 23, 27-36, 47, 51, 59-80; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2020), Articles 6, 17 and 31; Special Administrative Measures for Foreign Investment Access (Negative List 2024 Edition); Regulations on the Registration Administration of Market Entities (State Council Order No. 746, 2022), Articles 5-9 and 16-22.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), acting through the local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation (Market Entity Registration Division) with territorial jurisdiction over the proposed registered office.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Market Entity, together with the signed Articles of Association, the Name Pre-approval Notice, the First Board Resolution, and the supporting notarized and apostilled corporate documents.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None. No statutory minimum registered capital is imposed for a wholly foreign-owned enterprise engaged in craft beer and beverage wholesale and distribution under the 2024 Negative List. The sole shareholder determines the registered capital in the Articles of Association; the Company Law generally requires subscribed capital to be paid in full within five years of registration unless a shorter period is mandated by a special industry rule. No blocked escrow account is required for ordinary distribution activities, but the registered capital amount must be commercially consistent with the declared total investment, and the paid-in capital must be remitted through a bank acting as a State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) agent bank for direct investment foreign exchange registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [●] WFOE LIMITED (THE 'COMPANY')

WHEREAS, the sole founding shareholder has caused the Company to be incorporated as a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company under the Company Law of the People's Republic of China; and WHEREAS, the first Board of Directors is empowered by the Articles of Association to transact the organizational matters necessary for the lawful commencement of business.

NOW, THEREFORE, the undersigned directors, comprising a quorum of the full board, waive notice of a formal meeting and unanimously adopt the following resolutions in solemn writing, effective as of the date set forth in the certificate below.

1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. RESOLVED, that the registered capital of the Company shall be the amount stated in the Articles of Association, denominated in RMB, divided into fully subscribed equity interests; that each subscriber irrevocably subscribes for its stated capital contribution; that contributions may be made in cash or lawfully contributed in kind; that each contribution shall be paid in full within five years from the date of issuance in accordance with Article 47 of the Company Law unless an earlier date is required by applicable regulation; and that the directors shall establish a capital contribution schedule, issue contribution notices, and take all actions necessary to receive lawfully paid-up capital without any blocked escrow arrangement.

2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. RESOLVED, that the Company shall adopt one or more licensed commercial banks as its principal depositories; that the Legal Representative and Chief Financial Officer, or such other officers as may be designated, shall be registered as signatories on all accounts; that all payment instructions exceeding RMB equivalent to US$10,000 shall require dual authorization by two designated directors; that wire transfers exceeding RMB equivalent to US$50,000 shall additionally require the Chairman's written approval; that each designated bank shall be authorized to open settlement accounts, foreign exchange capital accounts when permitted, and corporate payment platforms; and that all signatories shall comply with applicable anti-money laundering and know-your-customer obligations.

3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company shall be and hereby is fixed at the address stated in the Articles of Association and in the incorporation filing submitted to the competent Market Entity Registration authority; that the registered office shall be the statutory address for service of process and official notices; and that the executed lease, landlord consent, ownership certificate, and premises function certificate shall be placed in the Company's corporate records and shall be made available to the registry upon request.

4. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS. RESOLVED, that [Name] shall be and hereby is appointed Executive Director and Legal Representative; that [Name] shall be and hereby is appointed General Manager and Chief Compliance Officer; and that [Name] shall be and hereby is appointed Supervisor. The Supervisor shall not concurrently serve as a director or as the General Manager. The Legal Representative shall have full authority to execute regulatory applications, tax filings, customs registrations, bank account documents, and commercial contracts necessary for the lawful operation of the craft beer distribution business.

5. SEAL AND DOCUMENT CUSTODY. RESOLVED, that the Company shall adopt a corporate seal, finance seal, legal representative seal, and contract seal; that those seals shall be maintained under a dual-custody protocol by two designated officers; and that no seal shall be affixed outside the ordinary course of the Company's authorized wholesale, export, warehousing, and administrative business.

6. DELEGATED FILINGS. RESOLVED, that the professional services firm [Name] is engaged as the Company's formation and licensing agent with authority to file the establishment application, Articles of Association, First Board Resolution, food business license application, foreign trade operator registration, and customs registration, and to receive the Business License and all operating permits on behalf of the Company.

7. RATIFICATION. RESOLVED, that all lawful acts performed by the promoter, the shareholder, and the formation agent prior to the date of this resolution for the purposes of organizing and registering the Company are hereby ratified, adopted, and approved in all respects.

CERTIFIED this [●] day of [●], [●]. [Signature] [Name], Corporate Secretary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-registration Name Reservation and Business Scope Screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) online enterprise name reservation portal and the local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation counter.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed wholly foreign-owned enterprise name and permitted business scope through the SAMR national name reservation system or the local market entity registration window. The proposed name must comply with the mandatory arrangement of administrative division, distinctive trade name, industry heading, and limited company type. For a craft beer distribution business, the industry heading should refer to beverage wholesale, alcohol wholesale, or cold-chain supply chain services rather than brewing, unless the entity also holds a brewing production license. The foreign shareholder must provide an apostilled certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, board authorization for the incorporation, and passport copies of the proposed legal representative, with certified English or Chinese translations where the source language is not English. The registrar will reject names that are identical or confusingly similar to existing enterprises or registered trademarks. The resulting name reservation notice is valid for six months and may be extended once before filing the establishment application.
required_dossiers: Name pre-approval application form
Proposed business scope in both English and Chinese equivalent
Apostilled certificate of incorporation of the sole foreign investor
Apostilled certificate of good standing, if available
Apostilled board resolution or power of attorney authorizing the WFOE formation
Passport copies of proposed legal representative, director, and supervisor
Lease draft or letter of intent for proposed registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is queried or rejected, select a new distinctive trade name or add a geographic or industry qualifier that avoids similarity and resubmit the application within the same portal. If the application is suspended because of identity documentation defects, obtain a new apostille or notarial translation and file a formal supplement within the registry's stated correction window; an adverse name decision may be challenged through administrative reconsideration before SAMR or through judicial administrative review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Establishment Registration and Issuance of Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation, Market Entity Registration Division, via the SAMR integrated online market entity registration platform or in-person acceptance window.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and submit the Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company together with the signed Articles of Association, name pre-approval notice, lease agreement, valid ownership or use certificate for the premises, landlord consent, investor identity documents, appointment instruments for the executive director, supervisor, legal representative and general manager, and the first board resolution. The business scope must precisely describe the wholesale, cold-chain storage, and export of craft beer and related beverages, and must include no items appearing on the foreign investment negative list. The application must disclose registered capital, total investment, shareholder details, duration, and legal representative information. The authority will verify the legality of the Articles, the authenticity of signatures, and the completeness of the registration dossier, then issue the Business License with a unified social credit code and make the company record publicly available in the national enterprise credit information publicity system.
required_dossiers: Market entity establishment registration application form
Signed Articles of Association
Name pre-approval notice
Lease contract, landlord title certificate, premises function certificate, and landlord consent
Apostilled investor certificate of incorporation and identity documents
Appointment letters for executive director, supervisor, legal representative, and general manager
First Board Resolution
Compliance undertaking confirming no negative-list restriction applies
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or suspended, the registry will issue a written notice of correction identifying the missing forms, signatures, or supporting certificates. The applicant may cure the deficiency through the online platform within the prescribed correction period, usually five working days, without losing the filing priority. If the substance is rejected on capital or business-scope grounds, amend the Articles and resubmit; an unlawful rejection may be appealed by administrative reconsideration or through an administrative lawsuit before the competent people's court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Food Business License for Cold-Chain Alcoholic Beverage Wholesale
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Administration for Market Regulation, Food Business Licensing Department, operating under the Food Safety Law of the People's Republic of China.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after obtaining the Business License, submit the Food Business License application covering cold-chain food sales, pre-packaged food distribution, and alcoholic beverage wholesale. The application package must describe the refrigerated storage rooms, keg and bottle storage conditions, continuous temperature monitoring plan, hygiene and sanitation procedures, product recall and traceability system, and shelf-life control methodology. If the WFOE will distribute craft beer produced by a third-party microbrewery, the application must include the brewery's information and the relevant production license numbers. The authority will conduct an on-site inspection of the warehouse premises, cold rooms, temperature alarms, drainage, pest control measures, protective equipment, and food safety signage. The Food Business License will state the permitted sales methods and the operating address. The license must be displayed in a conspicuous place and renewed before expiration.
required_dossiers: Food Business License application form
Business License and unified social credit code certificate
Legal representative and food safety responsible person identity documents
Cold-chain warehouse floor plan and refrigeration capacity statement
Food safety management system, HACCP sanitation manual, and recall plan
Temperature calibration certificates and monitoring device records
Health certificates for food safety personnel
Site inspection checklist and any prior correction request correspondence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the on-site inspection identifies deficiencies, the applicant must rectify sanitation conditions, install missing thermometers or pest-control devices, and submit photographic and documentary proof of correction within the specified period, ordinarily not exceeding twenty working days. If the application is denied, the company may appeal under the Food Safety Law and the Administrative Reconsideration Law; reapplication may be made once the non-conformity is fully remediated.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Social Insurance, and Finance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Tax Service of the State Taxation Administration via the Electronic Tax Bureau; Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; and commercial banks designated by the People's Bank of China and SAFE for foreign exchange administration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the automatic post-incorporation tax registration using the unified social credit code through the Electronic Tax Bureau, verify the taxpayer's legal representative identity, accounting standards, and corporate income tax branch of authority, and apply for registration as a value-added tax general taxpayer given the wholesale distribution model with a substantial annual revenue expectation. Register the statutory invoice title, electronic invoice quota, and monthly tax filing obligations. Within thirty days of establishment, complete employer registration with the Human Resources and Social Security Bureau for pension, medical, unemployment, work-injury, and maternity insurance schemes and enroll all employees into the social insurance system. If the basic deposit account has not yet been opened, prioritize that action before concluding tax filing arrangements. Maintain payroll, expense, fixed-asset, and cold-chain logistics records in accordance with Chinese accounting standards for later tax inspections and customs audits.
required_dossiers: Business License and unified social credit code certificate
Legal representative and financial officer identity documents
Board resolution delegating tax and social insurance matters
Basic deposit account certificate, if already issued
Employee register and payroll system documentation
Lease or property right certificate for the registered office
Company seal and finance seal specimen cards
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax registration is blocked because of missing bank account information, open the basic deposit account first and then update the tax authority through the Electronic Tax Bureau. If social insurance registration is queried due to a discrepancy between the employee roster and payroll, provide corrected employment contracts and statutory payroll records. Administrative penalties may be mitigated by voluntarily disclosing the non-compliance and completing the registration before the first inspection notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Foreign Direct Investment Capital Contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A licensed commercial bank acting as a SAFE agent bank for foreign direct investment, at the local branch with jurisdiction over the registered office; supporting filings through the SAFE direct investment information registration system.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the company's basic deposit account in RMB and, where required, a foreign currency capital account for FDI remittances. Present the Business License, Articles of Association, First Board Resolution, legal representative passport, supervisor identity document, lease agreement, seal cards, and completed anti-money laundering and ultimate beneficial ownership questionnaires. The bank will register the foreign shareholder and the capital contribution in the SAFE online direct investment system before the first remittance. The foreign investor must wire the subscribed capital from its own bank account using a remittance reference clearly identifying the contribution as registered capital of the WFOE. The bank will perform foreign exchange purchase and settlement, issue a transaction voucher, and record the capital contribution in the company's foreign exchange monitoring records. No prior SAFE approval is required for ordinary wholesale activities, but all non-compliant attempts to use the capital account for unauthorized purposes must be rejected by the bank.
required_dossiers: Business License and Articles of Association
First Board Resolution designating account signatories and capital contribution instructions
Legal representative passport and supervisor identity document
Company corporate seal, finance seal, and legal representative seal specimen cards
Lease agreement and proof of physical office presence
AML/KYC questionnaire and ultimate beneficial ownership declaration
Foreign investor remittance instruction referencing FDI registered capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the source of funds or the ownership chain, provide the apostilled articles and audited financial statements of the foreign investor or a board resolution explaining any intra-group financing. If the remittance reference is inconsistent with the registered business scope, correct the remittance description or file an amendment to the Articles with SAMR. Where SAFE records conflict with the bank's settlement certificate, submit the bank voucher to SAFE for reconciliation and, if necessary, re-file the direct investment registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Trade Operator Registration and Customs Export Clearance Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Commerce via the online Foreign Trade Operator Registration System; General Administration of Customs via the China International Trade Single Window; and, where applicable, the local customs office for food export supervision.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receipt of the Business License and Food Business License, register the WFOE as a foreign trade operator with the Ministry of Commerce through the online Foreign Trade Operator Registration System and obtain the customs registration code with the General Administration of Customs through the China International Trade Single Window. The customs code is necessary for every future export declaration of craft beer. Because the WFOE acts as a distributor rather than a brewer, it must ensure that each upstream craft brewery holds the required production and food safety licenses, and that the exporter maintains purchase records, batch numbers, temperature logs, and laboratory analysis reports for each keg or bottle lot. If the destination jurisdiction requires sanitary certificate, certificate of origin, or importer-specific documentation, the WFOE must obtain those documents before shipment. Register the warehouse address with customs for supervision purposes and designate the legal representative as the customs declaration responsible officer.
required_dossiers: Business License and Food Business License
MOFCOM foreign trade operator registration form
GACC customs registration application form
Board resolution authorizing the export trading business
Cold-chain warehouse lease and facility qualification documents
Upstream brewery production license and food safety compliance records
Product food safety laboratory reports, certificate of origin, and international buyer purchase orders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the customs registration application is rejected due to a mismatched HS classification or incomplete exporter information, correct the harmonized system code for beer and beer-based beverages, re-upload the missing license documents, and resubmit through the Single Window within the correction window. If an export shipment is suspended at the border because of incomplete import-country certificates, retain the cargo at the original warehouse, supplement the required health certificate or certificate of origin, and request redelivery under a revised declaration. Administrative decisions can be appealed through customs administrative reconsideration.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipal Administration for Market Regulation for the Food Business License; Municipal Emergency Management Bureau and Fire and Rescue Detachment for fire safety acceptance; Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau for environmental registration and pollution discharge compliance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Business License covering cold-chain packaged alcoholic beverage wholesale and distribution; Foreign Trade Operator Registration; Customs Registration; Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate; and Environmental Registration Filing for the cold-chain warehouse and distribution facility.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau under the Ministry of Ecology and Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration (Filing) under the Class III environmental impact classification. No full Environmental Impact Report or Environmental Impact Statement is required because the project comprises only cold-chain keg and bottle storage, material handling, and wholesale distribution of craft beer, and does not involve brewing, fermentation, malting, bottling line operation, or fuel-fired boiler combustion.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Sanitary and cleaning wastewater discharged to the municipal sewer must comply with pH 6-9, COD not exceeding 500 mg/L, BOD5 not exceeding 300 mg/L, SS not exceeding 400 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen not exceeding 45 mg/L, or any stricter local sewer discharge standard. Volatile organic compounds from cleaning and refrigeration maintenance must be controlled under GB 37822-2019 with no visible fugitive emissions; solvent use must be confined to closed containers and waste solvent must not be poured to drains. Hazardous waste such as waste refrigeration oil, oil filters, fluorescent tubes, refrigerant canisters and aerosol containers must be stored in sealed and labeled containers in a dedicated hazardous waste room for not more than one year, and must be removed by a licensed hazardous waste transporter under an electronic hazardous waste transfer manifest. Ozone-depleting refrigerant substances such as CFC-11 and CFC-12 are prohibited; each cold-chain system shall be subject to annual leak inspection, and any rejected refrigerant must be recovered, stored, and destroyed in accordance with Ministry of Ecology and Environment regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate for the warehouse and cold storage premises under the Fire Protection Law and the Ministry of Emergency Management implementing rules; structural load inspection certificate covering pallet racking, mezzanines, cold-room floors, and any refrigerant plant platform; workplace safety final acceptance under the Work Safety Law following the 'three-simultaneous' requirement for safety facilities; occupational hazard registration and surveillance for cold-environment work, noise exposure, and forklift traffic; and civil defense (civil air defense) clearance is not applicable for a standard above-ground logistics building, but would be required if the project creates an underground storage area subject to civil air defense planning.

stage_2.extra: This output is a single-line JSON object intended for downstream automated processing. No Chinese characters appear in any field. For pure digital or consulting projects, the licensing section would state Not Applicable, but this craft beer wholesale and cold-chain distribution project requires the licenses listed above.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China, operating through provincial and municipal tax service bureaus; online registration, filing and clearance are handled through the national Electronic Tax Bureau portal ('Electronic Tax Bureau') and, for export transactions, the China Customs Single Window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE), the foreign investor first completes company formation with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), which issues a business license containing the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC). Within 30 days of business license issuance, the WFOE must complete tax registration through the Electronic Tax Bureau or local tax service hall; the USCC is the statutory Tax Identification Number (TIN) and VAT identification number for all PRC tax purposes. The WFOE must then complete customs registration with China Customs for import/export filing, register for VAT invoice issuance, and apply for general VAT taxpayer status if projected annual VAT-taxable sales will exceed the statutory threshold. For a foreign non-resident parent without a Chinese establishment, no separate Chinese TIN is ordinarily required unless it is directly liable for Chinese-source income tax; the WFOE remains the resident taxpayer for trading operations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The PRC does not operate check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections. A China WFOE is mandatorily classified as a Chinese tax resident enterprise subject to entity-level taxation on worldwide income. The only available status election is VAT taxpayer classification: below the annual sales threshold the WFOE may apply for small-scale taxpayer simplified VAT treatment, while above the threshold it is required to register as a general VAT taxpayer.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the People's Republic of China Value-Added Tax Law and implementing regulations administered by the State Taxation Administration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 in annual VAT-taxable sales is the threshold above which a taxpayer that is currently small-scale must register as a general VAT taxpayer. There is no minimum turnover exemption for basic tax registration; every WFOE must obtain tax registration within 30 days of obtaining its business license, regardless of revenue.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China requires electronic invoicing through the STA national invoice system. Full digitalised electronic VAT invoices are generated via the nationwide electronic invoice platform using the WFOE's Unified Social Credit Code, and are transmitted to the STA in near real-time with digital authentication controls. Before an input VAT credit can be claimed, the purchaser must authenticate the invoice through the statutory VAT invoice comprehensive platform. High-volume taxpayers integrate through API-based fiscal machine/e-invoice interfaces; all invoices carry mandatory digital signatures and anti-fraud tax control codes. No private invoice formats are recognised for VAT deduction unless issued through the STA-controlled system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export VAT zero-rating is available to a registered WFOE exporter for craft beer products that are physically exported from the PRC customs territory and sold to a non-resident buyer. The WFOE must hold foreign trade operator registration, customs export registration, and file an electronic export customs declaration. The exported goods must be covered by a valid export sales contract, shipped under transport documentation, and the proceeds must be collected from outside China. Where all conditions are met, VAT is charged at 0% on export and the attributable input VAT is refundable through the STA export tax rebate procedure. Cross-border digital services are not relevant to this craft beer distribution scope.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic customs exit record from China Customs Single Window)
Bill of Lading (sea or air waybill, as applicable)
Commercial invoice issued by the WFOE to the overseas buyer
Export contract or confirmed purchase order
VAT invoice(s) for exported goods issued through the STA electronic invoice system
Bank foreign exchange collection voucher evidencing receipt of export proceeds from the overseas buyer
Export proceeds verification record as recognised by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating and refund claims are subject to strict STA and Customs audit. If the required documentation is incomplete, the foreign exchange is not repatriated within the 180-day period, or the export declaration is found to be false, the taxpayer may be required to repay the VAT refund with late-payment surcharge, lose eligibility for export tax rebates, and be assessed an administrative penalty of 50% to 500% of the tax shortfall under the PRC Tax Administration Law. Customs may separately impose penalties for false export declarations; serious cases may attract criminal liability for tax evasion or smuggling against the responsible individuals and legal representatives.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed floating exchange-rate regime. The RMB is convertible for current-account transactions, including trade in goods, freight, insurance, royalties, interest, and profit remittances, subject to genuine-transaction verification. Capital-account transactions remain regulated and are opened through SAFE registrations, quotas, and approvals on a case-by-case basis. A WFOE receiving equity capital from abroad is treated as foreign direct investment and must complete SAFE FDI registration before the onshore bank can open and credit the capital-account escrow account. Current-account export proceeds for cold-chain keg sales must be repatriated to China and credited to an export settlement account; they can be retained in foreign currency within the SAFE-approved quota or converted into RMB at the onshore market rate. Profit remittance to the foreign parent is permitted after annual audited financial statements, the corporate income tax settlement, the legal reserve fund allocation, and the required dividend withholding tax certificate have been completed. SAFE monitors trade flows through cross-referencing customs declarations, commercial invoices, bills of lading, and payment records. Capital-account outflows such as external debt repayments, intercompany loans, and foreign equity investments require specific registration and cannot be executed freely. Exchange-rate risks are managed through the PBOC daily fixing and the ±2 percent onshore RMB/USD trading band, while hedging products must meet the real-demand principle.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds for goods must be repatriated into China within 180 days from the date of export customs declaration, unless the bank has registered an approved deferred collection extension under exceptional open-account trade terms. The proceeds may be retained in foreign currency on the exporter's SAFE-verified settlement account up to the enterprise's approved retention quota; any amount above that quota must be converted into RMB at the market exchange rate. There is no mandatory fixed conversion ratio for qualifying exporters, but the entire receipt must be either retained within the quota or settled through a licensed Chinese bank before the SAFE trade monitoring system closes the associated export collection file.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: RMB Basic Deposit Account, Foreign Exchange Settlement Account, and FDI Capital Injection Escrow Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: RMB Basic Deposit Account and SAFE-registered Foreign Exchange Capital Account
RMB Basic Deposit Account and Export Proceeds Retention Account
RMB Basic Deposit Account and Cold-Chain Trade Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Conditional / Low for primary treasury use. Offshore fintech EMIs are not licensed as deposit-taking institutions in Mainland China and cannot open the statutory RMB basic deposit account or SAFE-designated capital-account for a WFOE. They cannot provide clearing in the CIPS system or issue commercial documentary letters of credit. A WFOE engaged in cold-chain craft beer distribution must maintain its primary account relationship with a licensed PRC commercial bank. Domestic fintech payment institutions with a SAFE cross-border RMB/FX pilot license may be used as auxiliary gateways for collection and reconciliation of small-value cross-border e-commerce payments, but they cannot replace the bank for export proceeds repatriation, FX settlement, or capital injection compliance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The legal representative is generally required to appear in person at the Chinese bank branch for the initial corporate account opening, UBO identification, and AML KYC interview. Remote consular proxy opening is not an automatic statutory right; however, most tier-1 banks accept a notarized power of attorney, apostilled or consularized in the home jurisdiction, translated into Chinese, combined with a live video interview between the bank compliance officer and the absent legal representative. The account signatories and the company seal custodian must also attend in person, and the bank will verify the board resolution appointing the authorized operator.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Layered offshore parent holding structure with nominee shareholders or opaque beneficial ownership triggers enhanced due diligence and the bank may decline the WFOE account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation and Register of Directors for each entity in the ownership chain; notarized ultimate beneficial owner passport and proof of identity; trust deed or foundation deed if applicable; signed UBO declaration in Chinese; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence; six months of bank statements for the direct shareholder; organizational chart mapping shareholding percentages and control rights; board resolution authorizing the WFOE account opening and signatory schedule.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-flow mismatch red flag caused by export invoices, customs declarations, and shipping documents that do not reconcile in value, volume, HS code, or cold-chain route.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed commercial contracts with the overseas distributor; packing lists and weight certificates; original bills of lading and sea/air waybills; customs export declarations; HAS/health certificates for the craft beer; temperature-logged cold-chain tracking reports; freight and insurance invoices; payment receipts from the buyer; and a spreadsheet reconciling each payment to the corresponding customs clearance record.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Missing or expiring industry-specific licenses for alcohol production and wholesale distribution causes the bank to classify the entity as unlicensed trade activity and blocks onboarding.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Food Business License; Alcohol Sales License or alcohol wholesale permit; production license for the microbrewery if brewing on site; customs import/export registration certificate; tax registration; lease or ownership proof for the cold-chain warehouse; local commercial bureau filings; and the business license expressly covering ISIC 4632 wholesale and export of malt beverages.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Dividend and profit remittance pattern resembles round-tripping or disguised capital flight when the bank sees inbound equity capital followed by large outbound shareholder distributions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAFE FDI registration certificate and bank-issued capital contribution receipt; audited financial statements for the WFOE for at least two years; corporate income tax settlement and tax clearance certificates; dividend withholding tax payment vouchers; legal reserve fund allocation confirmation; board resolution declaring the dividend; schedule of retained earnings; and a written statement of no domestic encumbrance on the distributable profits.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity capital must be routed through SAFE's FDI registration system. The WFOE must first complete FDI registration with the onshore bank or SAFE, then open a dedicated foreign-exchange capital account. The overseas parent should send an SWIFT MT103 wire to that account using the FDI equity contribution purpose code specified in the SAFE cross-border receipt/payment code list and must reference the WFOE's Articles of Association and FDI registration number. The receiving bank will perform a capital verification matching the remitter, the amount, the currency, and the registration. After settlement into RMB, the funds may be used only for permitted operating purposes under the negative list, including purchase of brewing equipment, cold-chain infrastructure, raw materials, rent, salaries, and the entity's normal trade disbursements. The WFOE must not use capital inject funds for unauthorized domestic equity investment, onshore loans, or repayment of RMB loans unless permitted by SAFE.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For settlements with overseas suppliers including hops, packaging, refrigeration parts, and freight services, the WFOE will use mainstream clearing rails. Direct open-account payments are executed via SWIFT MT103 with proper underlying trade contracts, invoices, customs declarations if applicable, and logistics evidence. Commercial letters of credit are issued through MT700/MT707 and settled against compliant drafts and transport documents. Documentary collections are cleared through bank-to-bank presentation of title documents under URC 522. For RMB-denominated cross-border trade, the WFOE may settle through CIPS and SWIFT CNY channels while keeping separate current-account files for export and import transactions. All outbound payments must match the real trade background and be retained in the bank's trade FX monitoring file.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forwards for current-account receipts and payments, approved external debt, and FDI-related exposures with notional value strictly limited to verified underlying exposure and maturity aligned to the trade contract.
FX swaps between RMB and eligible foreign currencies for managing short-term trade settlement timing mismatches, entered only with a licensed Chinese bank under real-demand documentation.

Cross-currency swaps (CCS) for converting long-term foreign-currency liabilities or equity-related exposure into RMB-linked obligations, subject to SAFE capital-account approval and bank credit and collateral requirements.
Plain-vanilla FX options used only for hedging, not proprietary trading, where the premium and strike structure are within the SAFE real-demand framework.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not generally permissible as a standalone resident-entity hedge in Mainland China; access is limited to specific structures booked through a licensed onshore bank under a SAFE-approved program and must be supported by genuine foreign-currency exposure and settlement through designated accounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Information Publicity Report (Enterprise Annual Report) under Regulations on the Administration of Enterprise Information Publicity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between 1 January and 30 June for the preceding calendar year; new entities must file from the first annual cycle after establishment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file within the window results in inclusion in the List of Enterprises with Abnormal Business Operations; if not remedied within three years, the enterprise faces revocation of its business license by the market supervision authority

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Information Report under the Interim Measures for the Reporting of Foreign Investment Information
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) via the Foreign Investment Information Reporting System, coordinated with SAMR annual report filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June for the preceding calendar year, aligned with the SAMR annual report submission
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or false reporting may incur administrative warnings and fines; habitual non-reporting can lead to restrictions on foreign investor rights and regulatory compliance downgrade

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Final Settlement and Filing (Annual CIT Return, Form A12000)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) via local tax bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 May of the following year from the end of the tax year; WFOE generally uses the calendar year unless special approval is obtained for a different fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties of RMB 200 to RMB 2,000 per return (approximately USD 28 to USD 280), plus daily late payment surcharge of 0.05% of overdue tax; persistent delinquency triggers tax collection enforcement and possible blacklisting

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Stamp Duty Annual Declaration and Payment Comprehensive Self-Inspection Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 April for the preceding calendar year declaration of all taxable instruments
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Under-declaration triggers a penalty of 50% to 300% of the underpaid tax, plus daily late payment interest of 0.05%; severe cases involve administrative enforcement action

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Individual Income Tax Annual Comprehensive Withholding Reconciliation for Employees (Employer-furnished records and year-end IIT settlement)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 May for individual annual reconciliation filing; employer withholding summary returns must be filed by 31 January after the tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: IIT withholding penalties of 50% to 300% of underpaid tax; late filings attract daily late payment surcharge of 0.05%; responsible officers may face personal fines

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Audit Report Submission to Regulatory and Banking Counterparties (when statutory audit is applicable)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Included in enterprise annual filing to SAMR; also furnished to foreign exchange regulators, banks, and investors upon request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Audit report must be completed and signed before 30 June annual filing deadline, ideally within 60 days of year-end for banking covenant compliance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to present an audited report where legally required may result in administrative inspection, fines, or disqualification from preferential tax treatment and foreign exchange remittance privileges

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Compulsory independent audit is triggered for all Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprises (WFOE) under the PRC Company Law and the Accounting Law. Specifically, every limited liability company must engage a certified public accountant to audit its annual financial report. Additional triggers include: (i) any enterprise that solicits foreign investment, applies for foreign exchange, or benefits from tax incentives; (ii) balance sheet total exceeding RMB 50,000,000 (approximately USD 6.9 million); (iii) annual turnover exceeding RMB 20,000,000 (approximately USD 2.8 million) for wholesale and distribution enterprises; (iv) a workforce headcount above 100 employees; (v) any enterprise categorized as a large or medium-sized enterprise under the SME classification standards or engaged in licensed food/alcohol distribution requiring annual regulatory attestation. In practice, all WFOEs regardless of size must file audited financial statements with the annual report while the audit exemption applies only to very small sole proprietorships not relevant here.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Chinese Accounting Standards (CAS) as issued by the Ministry of Finance and converged with IFRS; entities may voluntarily apply IFRS directly upon approval for overseas financing, but statutory reports must comply with CAS; the Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE) form the primary GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: China requires WFOEs to maintain a Beneficial Owner Register reflecting ultimate natural persons who ultimately own or control the entity. Any change in ultimate shareholders, shareholding percentage, controllers, or actual controllers must be filed with the local Market Supervision Authority through the Company Registration System within 30 days from the date of change. No separate annual UBO confirmation filing exists; instead, the annual SAMR information report must confirm the identity and shareholding structure of shareholders, actual controllers, and ultimate beneficial owners including changes during the reporting period. Failure to disclose material changes within the 30-day window may trigger administrative penalties under the Foreign Investment Law and the Measures on Registration of Shareholders.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Charges and Other Security Interests
Minute Book of Shareholders' Meetings, Board Meetings, and Supervisory Meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 - USD 1,500 per year for registered address and corporate secretarial agent
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 - USD 5,000 for certified CPA audit of a small to mid-size WFOE with annual turnover below USD 10 million

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard corporate income tax rate under CIT Law Article 4
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No automatic free-zone tax holiday applies to a distribution WFOE; a 15% preferential rate may apply only if the company qualifies as a High/New Technology Enterprise or Small Low-Profit Enterprise; no patent box applies; an additional 100% deduction is available for qualifying R&D expenses, though a wholesale distribution business rarely involves eligible R&D.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Income Tax Settlement Return, Type A (Form A100000) with supporting schedules, filed through the electronic tax bureau e-filing portal of the State Taxation Administration; quarterly provisional CIT prepayments are filed using the CIT Quarterly Prepayment Return (Form A200000) through the same portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly prepayment returns are due within 15 days after the end of each calendar quarter; the annual settlement return and full self-assessment are due within five months after the fiscal year-end, ordinarily before May 31 of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross sales revenue from craft beer kegs, packaged beer, and logistics/distribution services recognized under Chinese Accounting Standards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all worldwide revenue; reconcile export revenue with customs declarations; intercompany sales to foreign related distributors must be booked at arm's-length prices and supported by a contemporaneous transfer pricing study.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs including raw materials, hops, malt, yeast, cold-chain keg logistics, warehousing, freight, and direct labor.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Costs paid to non-resident affiliates must be evidenced by service contracts, customs entries, invoices, and proof of actual service; management or allocation charges without economic benefit are non-deductible and must be added back on the adjustment schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 (Line 3) - Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Marketing, distribution channel costs, insurance, rent, utilities, salaries, depreciation, and general overhead.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border royalties, consultancy fees, or technical service fees must satisfy business-purpose and economic-substance tests; Chinese withholding tax borne by the WFOE on behalf of the offshore recipient is not deductible; any related-party mark-up must be arm's-length.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 (Line 4) - Non-Taxable Income and Tax-Exempt Income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income items exempt from CIT, such as qualified dividends from resident investees or qualifying government subsidies; normally nil for a WFOE.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders cannot avoid Chinese tax by characterizing dividend distributions as loans or fee income; fee-based recharacterization will trigger non-resident withholding and penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 (Line 5) - Accounting Profit before Tax Adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Book profit after applying PRC Accounting Standards, including foreign-exchange gains and losses, impairment provisions, and asset write-downs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compare accounting profit with CIT taxable income; profits attributable to a foreign permanent establishment remain taxable in China unless a treaty allocation eliminates double taxation; foreign tax credits must be claimed through Schedule A108000.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deduction for prior-year losses available to offset current-year taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses may generally be carried forward five years; qualified high-tech enterprises may use a ten-year carryforward; no loss carryback applies; complete Schedule A106000 and maintain separate evidence for losses generated from cross-border transactions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 (Line 7) - Taxable Income After Adjustments and Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after netting tax-exempt income, tax adjustment items, loss carryforward, and before applying the statutory rate and tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any transfer pricing adjustment made by the tax authority on related-party beer sales must be reflected here; excess interest expenses under thin-capitalization rules are disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 (Line 8) - Income Tax Payable and Foreign Tax Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax calculated at 25% or another applicable rate, reduced by foreign tax credits and other statutory credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The future dividend withholding tax on profit repatriation is not creditable against CIT; the WFOE must withhold and file separate non-resident withholding returns when the board resolves to distribute profits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return attracts a fine up to RMB 2,000 under Tax Collection Administration Law Article 62, or up to RMB 10,000 in serious cases; late payment accrues a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax under Article 32; fraudulent understatement or false returns attract a penalty from 50% to 5 times the amount of underpaid tax under Article 63; failure to withhold tax attracts a penalty from 50% to 3 times the unwithheld amount under Article 69; where tax evasion reaches criminal thresholds, responsible directors and officers face imprisonment under Criminal Law Article 201.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on gross outbound dividends paid by a Chinese resident enterprise to a non-resident enterprise shareholder, under CIT Law Article 37 and Implementation Regulation Article 91; the standard 20% statutory rate is reduced to 10% by State Council rules.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim a reduced treaty rate, the non-resident shareholder must be the beneficial owner and obtain a valid Tax Residency Certificate issued by the treaty jurisdiction for the calendar year; the shareholder must submit a Beneficial Ownership statement and supporting evidence of substantive business, board resolutions, share register, financial statements, and risk-bearing capacity; the WFOE must file the non-resident withholding tax return and attach the treaty relief application before or at the time of payment; a conduit arrangement with no real activity will be denied treaty benefits, and retroactive denial leads to full 10% withholding, late-interest, and penalties.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rate is 10% for outbound royalties and interest; treaty rates generally range from 5% to 10% depending on jurisdiction; for example, the China-Hong Kong DTA applies 7% to qualifying interest and royalties, while the China-US DTA generally reserves 10%; arm's-length pricing and beneficial-ownership requirements apply regardless of treaty rate.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is required when controlled tangible-property transactions exceed RMB 200,000,000; controlled intangible-asset transactions exceed RMB 100,000,000; controlled financial-asset transactions exceed RMB 100,000,000; or other controlled transactions exceed RMB 40,000,000; Master File is required when aggregate related-party transactions in a single year exceed RMB 1,000,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Mainland China does not apply UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations to onshore WFOEs, but CIT Law Articles 45 and 47 and the Beneficial Ownership standard require the WFOE to conduct its core income-generating activities in China. For a craft beer distribution WFOE, CIGA includes demand forecasting, inventory ownership and risk, cold-chain logistics control, customer contracting, pricing, credit, and insurance. A WFOE hollowed out into an offshore shell, or a shareholder claiming treaty benefits without substance, will lose relief and face recharacterization.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE has no staff, office, inventory, cold-chain logistics, or decision-making presence in China, and is interposed solely to book low-margin distribution income and pass dividends to a Hong Kong or other treaty resident intermediary with no substantive business or risk-bearing capacity; the intermediary claims a lower treaty dividend rate without conducting activity on the ground.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: CIT Law Article 47 and Implementation Regulation Article 120 authorize recharacterization where an arrangement lacks reasonable commercial purpose; treaty benefits are denied; the underpaid CIT and withholding tax become payable with 0.05% daily late-interest and a penalty of 50% to 5 times the underpaid tax under Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under PRC Company Law Article 23 (2023 revision), courts may pierce the corporate veil where shareholders or directors abuse limited liability; directors may be jointly and severally liable for civil restitution of diverted funds or unpaid tax; the legal representative may be exit-banned or blacklisted for unresolved tax liabilities, and intentional evasion can trigger imprisonment for up to seven years under Criminal Law Article 201.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation and Thin Capitalization
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE sells hazy IPA kegs to an offshore related distributor below cost or at a sub-2% net margin while transferring functions, risks, and intangibles offshore; alternatively, it pays excessive royalties or group service fees that strip Chinese profit and borrows from the non-resident parent beyond the statutory 2:1 debt-to-equity safe harbor without an arm's-length interest rate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: CIT Law Articles 41 and 46, Implementation Regulations Articles 119-123, and SAT Public Notice No. 42/2016 authorize adjustment; the tax authority applies the best arm's-length method, disallows excess interest, adjusts taxable income, and charges special tax adjustment interest at a punitive margin over the base rate in addition to the 0.05% daily late payment surcharge; false transfer pricing documentation is penalized under Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63 at 50% to 5 times the underpaid tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly execute sham transfer pricing agreements may be named in the tax adjustment and held personally liable if corporate assets were diverted through fake invoices or round-tripped loans; criminal exposure for fraudulent tax evasion can lead to imprisonment; personal bank accounts and travel rights may be restricted until restitution is made.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax Evasion on Profit Repatriation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The board distributes or credits dividends to the non-resident parent but classifies the remittances as consulting fees, loan repayments, transfer pricing settlements, or management charges; no non-resident withholding return is filed; no Tax Residency Certificate or Beneficial Ownership file is maintained; a false treaty claim is made without substantive business in the treaty jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: CIT Law Articles 3, 37, and 38 require the withholding agent to withhold and remit 10% on outbound dividends, interest, and royalties; Tax Collection Administration Law Article 69 imposes a fine of 50% to 3 times the unwithheld tax on the WFOE, plus daily late payment interest under Article 32; fraudulent withholding returns are subject to Article 63 fraud penalties and potential criminal prosecution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative and financial director are personally exposed: civil restitution of the unwithheld tax, personal fines, exit bans and blacklisting until taxes are settled, and criminal imprisonment for up to seven years where the intentional false payment scheme constitutes tax evasion; courts may disregard the corporate entity where the WFOE was operated as the shareholder's alter ego.
